test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A cistern 8 m long and 4 m wide contains water up to a depth of 1 m 22 cm. Then the total area of the wet surface is:
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the cistern = 8 m

Width of the cistern = 4 m

Depth of the water = 1 m 22 cm = 1.22 m

**Formula Used:**

Total area of the wet surface = Area of the base + Area of the four walls

**Calculation:**

Area of the base = Length × Width

⇒ Area of the base = 8 × 4 = 32 m²

Area of the two longer walls = 2 × (Length × Depth)

⇒ Area of the two longer walls = 2 × (8 × 1.22)

⇒ Area of the two longer walls = 2 × 9.76 = 19.52 m²

Area of the two shorter walls = 2 × (Width × Depth)

⇒ Area of the two shorter walls = 2 × (4 × 1.22)

⇒ Area of the two shorter walls = 2 × 4.88 = 9.76 m²

Total area of the wet surface = Area of the base + Area of the two longer walls + Area of the two shorter walls

⇒ Total area of the wet surface = 32 + 19.52 + 9.76 = 61.28 m²

**The total area of the wet surface is 61.28 m².**
